opening.argument: The video presents a Forsage BUSD activation walkthrough built around wallet-based payments and successive recruitment levels. It directs viewers to approve BUSD through a smart contract, then instructs them to activate another level after showing an X4 panel with partners, percentage figures, and a 10 BUSD activation amount. The speaker identifies that “your 1st level is activated” and says, “We've reached 2nd level of X4,” establishing a tiered structure rather than a standalone transaction. It also connects the referral process to the unclear claim that “you can get placed to the bank,” while asking viewers to use a referral URL. Together, these instructions make the presentation a crypto and recruitment solicitation.
